schema.begun_session: a session begun and never ended, drawn as the tape's end, else null
schema.design: the run's design variables as recorded, memory as read
schema.families: the selection's families holding the run
schema.sessions[]: per session: status (submitted, malformed, refused), editor_session, page_kept, letter_kept, received (channels, from_sessions, slot or accumulative visibility), time (what the agent was told)
schema.sessions[].received.slot.held (zoe-2.1): on a session whose predecessor was malformed or refused (held_after names which), what the slot held, read from the session's first request: response_as_it_stood (the predecessor's unusable response delivered as it stood; held_empty true where that response had no text), empty_letter_notice (notice: the harness's words), notice (another harness notice, named), ordinary_letter (the predecessor kept a letter and the slot holds it; the status hides an ordinary handoff), other (named in note)
schema.sessions[].received.slot.grain (zoe-2.1): the stack's four rows counted over the held text, by the rule that counts a letter: [{rank, label, count}], a row absent with its reason where the corpus has no topic regex; null with grain_absent where the slot held no text to count
schema.term, passage, term_tier, term_rule: the traced term and passage, or term_tier 'absent' and the reason
schema.deliveries, other_term_deliveries, pages: as the six's exports; by_name rungs name their channel; a stack row may be absent with its reason
schema.bars: semantic_distance, session_running, return_gap per session; baseline: the key into baselines-all.json, or null
schema.provenance: dataset DOI and version, the analysis code's commit and dirty flag, the export command
one plain sentence saying why the run traces its term and passage, written from the export's term_rule by zoetrope_sentences.py; says where a tie or the fallback test decided
schema.runs[].told (index, zoe-2.1): on the accidents family only: {words: what the score told the run it would receive, in the harness's words; line: that beside what it received}; null where what it was told matches what it received (checked)

families.memory: What each session receives from earlier sessions, varied with everything else held: a letter, nothing, every earlier page, or the whole conversation (s7 Study at n=3; none against Study on s36).
families.sink: The sink as apparatus: a consult that continues to the next passage, and one consult a session, against the call-slip runs of the same genres.
families.censored: Censored handoffs: a closing directive the provider's classifier refuses in many sessions, against the Study triplet.
families.providers: The same conditions run by GPT and Gemini beside Claude, on two corpora.
families.time: What the run tells the agent about time: 'Nothing is due.' appended, or a stop offered from session 30.
families.accidents: The record's own accidents: runs told one memory and given another, runs halted when the credit ran out, and the accumulative object.
families.corpus: The fiction corpus against the other two: Study, progress report and questions on s105 beside the same genres on s7 and s36.

index.common_caption: One run: a reading, not a result. Deliveries are returns of the traced passage from each session's last-attempt consults; returns of other passages bearing the term are kept apart and not drawn. Rungs grade sentences holding the term by shared 5-word shingles with the traced passage delivered that session and by what the session received from earlier sessions, whatever the channel; no_traced_channel marks the term with neither. The semantic bar is the distance in meaning between the session's page and the traced passage (embeddinggemma-300M, as qmd embeds, title none); the session bar counts sessions since a page or letter last held the term. The tick is the median distance to the passage of pages from the same corpus's straight-letter runs written before the passage or its term reached them, in six-session bands; dashed where fewer than 30 pages or 5 runs stand behind it, or no run among them never received the passage.
